title: Hybrid init+gen scheduler with attention-cost estimator
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and implement a hybrid scheduling policy that treats the model request as two phases (init/prefetch and generation) and uses an attention-cost estimator to decide per-request phase splits and kernel selection. The scheduler should aim to improve overall GPU utilization and throughput for long context requests while bounding tail latency for short interactive requests. The estimator will use a lightweight attention-sparsity probe during the init phase to pick kernels and decide whether to split into microphases or run as a single fused pipeline.
comments: 2026-02-20 | Ava Martinez: Created ticket and initial PRD. Rationale: current one-size scheduler underutilizes kernels optimized for sparse attention on long contexts and over-prioritizes low-latency path for short chat requests leading to poor throughput efficiency.

2026-02-27 | Rajat Kapoor: Prototype of attention-cost probe landed in branch hybrid-initgen-probe. Probe adds a 50-100us overhead to init but provides a reliable sparsity score for kernel hints. Early microbench shows correct kernel choice for 87% of traces.

2026-03-02 | SRE (Lina Chen): Load-tests on staging with hybrid policy caused P95 latency regression for sub-32-token generation on cold-start GPUs. Hypothesis: probe overhead + phase-splitting increases scheduling overhead for tiny requests. Added backoff to avoid splitting for requests with expected gen tokens < 24.

2026-03-05 | Research (Diego Alvarez): Simulation results attached. For long-context workloads (avg seq 2048), throughput improved 1.9x and token cost reduced 32%. For mixed workloads (20% long, 80% short) P95 improved 12% but P99 for short tails increased 8ms. Need guardrail to prevent user-visible regressions.

2026-03-09 | UX/Console (Maya Patel): We need a per-model toggle + visibility in Console to allow canarying and to report attention-hint distribution. Suggested: add a "Hybrid Scheduler" flag in model route settings and a histogram with 'split rate' metric.

2026-03-12 | Rajat Kapoor: Implemented split-rate guardrail and kernel-hint caching. Re-ran staging load test: P95 short-request latency returned to baseline; long-request throughput still shows 1.7x improvement. Preparing RFC for rollout strategy and audit log entries.
2026-03-12 | PM (Owen Brooks): Approve experimental canary. Request adding a rollout plan with canary % steps and automatic rollback on P95 increase >5% for interactive routes.
